name: design-agents
description: Wireframes, UI design and UX/accessibility review that do not look AI-generated. Three agents — wireframer (flows, screen inventory, grayscale HTML wireframes exported to PNG), ui-designer (two to three design directions, one chosen with a reason, then built and audited for generic AI looks) and ux-reviewer (read-only usability, WCAG 2.2 AA and AI-look review) — plus the wame-ui-ux skill with the shared method. Platform rules come from laravel-nova-agents, laravel-filament-agents and ionic-agents when installed. Installs frontend-design and chrome-devtools-mcp with it.
